reserveReview.rationale: Current issuer documentation identifies tracked hbUSDT 0x5e105266db42f78fa814322bce7f388b4c2e61eb as its automated USDT strategy vault and describes instant and two-day classic exits. The previously pinned deposit-token review at HyperEVM block 40439370 identified USDT0, not direct USDT; USDT0's current deployment registry confirms HyperEVM token 0xb8ce59fc3717ada4c02eadf9682a9e934f625ebb. A fresh asset() probe on the depositor 0x6261f30144b259c74243d5f5d9230941186ac936 reverted at block 47265526 and does not supersede that deposit-token identity. The reserve row expresses the retained whole strategy-vault claim under D3, with an unverified USDT0 intermediary annotation; it does not quantify idle USDT0 or any constituent allocation. Canonical escrow coverage and current venue/position weights remain unreconciled. Source-scoped correction. Sources re-opened 2026-10-20: the exact vault guide advertises two-day classic processing and liquidity-dependent instant redemption, while the governing terms explicitly allow liquidity-related execution delays and inability to exit. No cited source establishes a seven-day whole-strategy reserve realization horizon. Only that unsupported horizon is withdrawn to unknown; the September 30 relationship review, composition date, parent dependency and historical deposit-token pins are preserved. No reserve weight or executable capacity is inferred.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Issuer exact vault/exit documentation and USDT0 deployment registry accessed 2026-09-30, with historical deposit-token identity at HyperEVM block 40439370
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Whole-book strategy weights, look-through assets, custody-provider shares and USDT0 canonical escrow coverage remain unreconciled. New first-layer issuer API research on 2026-10-20 identifies exact hbUSDT holdings valued at USD 1,452,572.43 in masterUSD, USD 148,802.37 through an hbUSDT-HL Hyperlend value proxy and USD 10 USDT0, totaling USD 1,601,384.80. Its last_scan value has no timezone and it supplies no hbUSDT supply, pending-claim or liability denominator; these are diagnostic issuer portfolio observations, not a current full-composition or financial reconciliation claim. No API percentages replace authored reserve weights, and the September relationship/composition clocks remain unchanged. The parent link describes settlement lineage only.
